title: I Started a $20K/Month Pickleball Club for $200
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast

stated_problem.quote: I wanted real people in this area to tell me would they pay for this most importantly how often do they want to play
stated_problem.speaker: Chris Koerner

idea.name: Private pickleball club memberships
idea.one_liner: Rent an underused building, sell monthly memberships and reservations to local pickleball players, and charge extra for additional play.
idea.customer: Local pickleball players, including beginners and groups who want a private court.
idea.offer: Memberships with 24/7 access and court reservations; extra play can cost more.
idea.revenue_model: Monthly membership fees, with additional fees for extra court time and possibly guests.

ideas.delivery: Members use key-card access to enter a rented building and reserve a private pickleball court. The operator must arrange the facility, maintenance, cleaning, utilities, and booking system.
